const input = $input.all();

const masterCreativeRules = {
  version: '1.0',
  audience: '18_plus_gaming_news',
  promise: 'sell_the_information_not_the_body',
  trendResearchWindowDays: 15,
  characterSelection: {
    lucia: 'Use when Lucia is the verified subject, for character/story coverage, or as a relevant lead in broad official GTA VI updates.',
    jason: 'Use when Jason is the verified subject, especially for vehicles, gameplay systems, technology, or story coverage.',
    duo: 'Use Lucia and Jason together for official updates, trailers, relationship/story beats, and broad GTA VI coverage.',
    otherCharacters: 'Use another named character only when that character is materially connected to the story.',
    never: 'Never add Lucia, Jason, or sexual appeal to an unrelated story only for clicks.'
  },
  thumbnail: {
    canvas: '1280x720',
    focalSubjectsMax: 2,
    headlineWordsMin: 2,
    headlineWordsMax: 4,
    mobileReadabilityRequired: true,
    highContrastRequired: true,
    mustBeOriginalComposition: true,
    doNotCloneCompetitorLayout: true,
    allowedClaimLabels: ['RUMOR', 'LEAK CLAIM', 'OFFICIAL', 'CONFIRMED'],
    forbidden: ['nudity', 'sex_act', 'explicit_pose', 'fake_gameplay', 'stolen_leak_frame', 'misleading_official_badge']
  },
  assetPolicy: {
    officialGallery: 'https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/media/screenshots',
    sourcePriority: ['direct_rockstar_asset', 'verified_press_asset_with_rights', 'original_generated_concept'],
    directOriginRequiredForOfficialLabel: true,
    leakedFramesMayBeAnalyzedButNeverReused: true,
    generatedArtMustBeLabeledConceptNotGameplay: true,
    luciaRedBikiniBeachRequest: {
      status: 'pending_direct_official_identity_confirmation',
      rule: 'Use only after a human confirms the exact file is from the Rockstar gallery and actually depicts Lucia. Otherwise create a non-explicit original red beach-outfit concept.'
    }
  },
  adultTopicPolicy: {
    allowed: true,
    mode: 'journalistic_non_explicit',
    sellInformationNotExplicitness: true,
    manualApprovalRequired: true,
    rewriteExplicitMetadata: true,
    neverUseExplicitVisuals: true
  },
  imageGeneration: {
    goal: 'original_editorial_thumbnail_background',
    charactersMustBeAdults: true,
    noNudity: true,
    noSexActs: true,
    noFetishFraming: true,
    noLogosByDefault: true,
    noTextInsideGeneratedImage: true,
    leaveNegativeSpaceForHeadline: true,
    safetyFallback: 'If a swimwear prompt is refused, switch to a fully clothed red beach outfit and preserve composition. Never evade safety filters.'
  },
  approvalGate: {
    requiredBeforeRender: true,
    requiredBeforePublish: true,
    noAutomaticPublishing: true
  }
};

if (input.length === 1 && input[0].json.radarEmpty) {
  const first = input[0].json;
  return [{
    json: {
      schemaVersion: '1.2',
      status: first.radarStatus || 'empty',
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      count: 0,
      officialCount: 0,
      requiresVerificationCount: 0,
      candidates: [],
      diagnostics: first.diagnostics || {},
      masterCreativeRules,
      message: first.status
    }
  }];
}

const candidates = input
  .map(item => item.json)
  .filter(item => !item.radarEmpty)
  .map(({ diagnostics, ...candidate }) => candidate)
  .sort((a, b) =>
    Number(b.official) - Number(a.official) ||
    b.viralScore - a.viralScore
  );

return [{
  json: {
    schemaVersion: '1.2',
    policyVersion: 'vicescope-master-1.0',
    status: 'ready_for_editorial_ai',
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    count: candidates.length,
    officialCount: candidates.filter(item => item.official).length,
    requiresVerificationCount: candidates.filter(item => item.verificationRequired).length,
    manualApprovalCount: candidates.filter(item => item.manualApprovalRequired).length,
    diagnostics: input[0]?.json?.diagnostics || {},
    editorialRules: {
      doNotInventFacts: true,
      evidenceBeforeEmotion: true,
      externalClaimsNeedConfirmation: true,
      resolveDiscoveryUrlsBeforeWriting: true,
      preferOfficialSources: true,
      narrationLanguage: 'en-US',
      approvalSummaryLanguage: 'pt-BR',
      primaryAudience: '18+',
      adultTopicsAllowed: true,
      adultTopicMode: 'journalistic_non_explicit',
      sellInformationNotBody: true,
      characterMustMatchStory: true,
      neverUseExplicitVisuals: true,
      rewriteExplicitMetadata: true,
      doNotReuseUnauthorizedLeaks: true,
      doNotPresentGeneratedArtAsOfficialOrGameplay: true,
      noAutomaticPublishing: true
    },
    masterCreativeRules,
    renderContract: {
      workflowFile: 'render.yml',
      narrationMaxCharacters: 1200,
      titleMaxCharacters: 50,
      subtitleMaxCharacters: 70,
      allowedVoices: ['am_adam', 'am_michael', 'af_heart', 'af_bella'],
      defaultVoice: 'am_adam',
      allowedSpeeds: ['0.95', '1.00', '1.08', '1.15'],
      defaultSpeed: '1.08'
    },
    candidates
  }
}];

## ViceScope — Radar GTA VI Master 1.2

1. Descobre pautas gratuitas e oficiais.
2. Verifica fonte, link, data e risco.
3. Aceita temas 18+ em modo jornalístico não explícito.
4. Nunca reutiliza frame vazado.
5. Escolhe Lucia, Jason, dupla ou outro personagem conforme a pauta.
6. Prioriza arte oficial verificada; alternativa é conceito original identificado.
7. Gera briefing de capa original com 2–4 palavras e leitura no celular.
8. Exige aprovação humana antes de renderizar e publicar.

A foto “Lucia de biquíni vermelho na praia” só pode ser chamada de oficial após confirmação do arquivo direto na galeria Rockstar.

Em teste manual, o n8n não persiste a memória de URLs. A deduplicação persiste em execução publicada pelo agendamento.
